properties.message_511: On I-95 at mile marker 119.6 in the County of Spotsylvania, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The south right shoulder is closed.
On VA-150 South in the County of Chesterfield, in the vicinity of Chippenham Rp, motorists can expect delays due to a vehicle crash. Lane closures exist.
On I-66 at mile marker 64 in the County of Fairfax, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The west right shoulder is closed.
On I-64 West in the City of Norfolk, at Hampton Roads Bridge Tunnel West, motorists can expect potential delays due to a bridge/tunnel stoppage.
